empty.title: No one invited yet
empty.body: Invite your first candidate and they will get a personal link to record their interview whenever suits them.

emptyDraft.title: Publish the role first
emptyDraft.body: Candidates can only be invited once the role is published.

invite.title: Invite candidates
invite.subtitle: Each person gets their own private link by email. They choose when to record.
invite.name: Name
invite.bulkPlaceholder:
Camille Durand, camille@example.com
Sam Okonkwo, sam@example.com
invite.bulkHint: Name and email separated by a comma or a semicolon. Lines that can't be read are shown back to you before anything is sent.
invite.duplicates: {{count}} already had an open invitation — their link was sent again.

cancelConfirm.title: Cancel this invitation?
cancelConfirm.body: {{name}}'s link will stop working. Anything they already recorded is kept.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete everything about this candidate?
deleteConfirm.body: {{name}}'s recordings, transcript, analysis and documents will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

errors.invalid_email: That is not a valid email address.
errors.too_many_candidates: Invite at most 100 people at a time.
errors.project_not_active: Publish the role before inviting candidates.
errors.session_closed: This interview is already finished or cancelled.
errors.site_url_not_configured: The site address is not configured, so invitation links cannot be built.
errors.rate_limited: That is a lot of invitations at once. Wait a moment and try again.
